descricoes_referencias.vanta_ficha.png: the official character reference sheet of Vanta (copy her design exactly; ignore the cigarette in the sheet)
descricoes_referencias.vanta_ficha_2.png: a close-up of Vanta's eyes: her RIGHT eye (image-left when facing the camera) is covered by the round black eclipse lens with a thin gold ring

texto_fixo.trava: VANTA — CHARACTER LOCK (copy exactly from the reference images) - Androgynous young adult, slim, relaxed slouchy posture, crooked knowing smile. - Hair: short, messy, midnight-navy (#24232A / #526F9A tones), shaggy bangs falling over the forehead. - Eyes: her LEFT eye (image-right when she faces the camera) is a normal amber-gold eye.  Her RIGHT eye (image-left when she faces the camera) is ALWAYS covered by a perfectly round black  "eclipse / black-hole" lens with a thin antique-gold ring and a small gold orbit loop — like a monocle.  This eclipse eye never moves to the other side, even when she turns. - Outfit: loose black suit jacket (sleeves slightly pushed up), ivory/off-white shirt, loose black tie,  high-waisted black trousers, a small muted-red star pin on the left lapel, a thin gold chain at the belt. - Accessories: gold orbital earrings (small planet with a ring), chunky black platform shoes (only in full body). - NEVER: both eyes normal, eclipse lens on the wrong eye, long hair, other hair color, colorful suit,  cigarette (do NOT draw cigarettes or smoke — the reference sheet has one, ignore it).
texto_fixo.estilo: ART STYLE (ASTRANEBEL): original 2D gothic-cosmic anime illustration with a classic 1980s hand-painted anime feel — drawn like a finished hand-inked anime illustration: crisp dark ink OUTLINES around every shape (face, hair strands, hands, clothes, ruffles, objects), confident clean line art with slightly thicker outer contour lines and thin inner detail lines, cel shading with one or two hard-edged shadow levels, smooth clean flat colors (no grain, no noise, no paper texture, no speckles, no watercolor blotches, no blur), melancholic elegant mood, strong readable silhouette. Exactly the drawing style of the character reference sheet. Palette: near-black #090A0F, charcoal #24232A, dusk blue #526F9A, soft blue #7C9EE8, ivory #F6E8D2, antique gold #C89B5B, muted crimson #A62636, silver gray #A7A9B3. Objects she holds are antique brass/gold, ivory paper or dark leather in the same style. Not 3D, not photorealistic, not glossy, not chibi, not a child.
texto_fixo.regras: FRAMING AND OUTPUT: a single character alone, half-body shot from the top of the head down to the hips; the hips are cut by the bottom edge of the image (no legs, no feet, no floor, no long skirt spreading out). The whole silhouette — hair, sleeves, ruffles — stays INSIDE the image with clear green margin on the left and on the right; nothing touches or is cut by the side edges; the character is centered and fills about 60–70% of the image width. Mouth CLOSED unless the pose asks for speaking. The WHOLE head and all the hair are inside the image, with clear empty green space above the top of the hair (never cut the head, the hair, the headband or ornaments by the top edge); the head is at the same height and scale as in the approved master. Plain flat solid chroma-key GREEN background (pure #00FF00) filling everything behind her, also between hair strands and between arms and body; no shadow on the ground, no gradient, no glow, no frame. Nothing green on the character or the objects (no green light, no green reflections, no green clothes). No text, no letters, no question marks, no speech bubbles, no sparkles, no watermark. Soft neutral front lighting. Clean edges.
